evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: payer or beneficiary clarity remains unverified outside the internal MVP artifact cases
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Determines whether future artifact refinement should focus on buyer, reviewer, learner, or operator evidence.
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Future work orders remain too generic to support externalization review.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: recipient archetype assumptions need external language before future publication or outreach review
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Clarifies whether generated value hypotheses map to builders, governance reviewers, operators, learners, sponsors, or future customers.
evidence_needs.expected_evidence_type: recipient terminology and need pattern evidence
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: The system risks overgeneralizing recipient archetypes.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: acceptance criteria for internal MVP proof artifacts need outside-facing comparator evidence
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Helps decide whether a proof artifact is reviewable enough for a future controlled observation pilot.
evidence_needs.expected_evidence_type: public checklist, evaluation rubric, or method comparison
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: MVP proof criteria stay internally plausible but externally uncalibrated.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: policy or platform constraints must be known before any future read-only pilot is approved
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Prevents future work orders from pointing to surfaces that require login, interaction, automation, or disallowed use.
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Observation approval packets cannot prove source-surface safety.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: distribution friction and source accessibility are untested on real surfaces
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Ranks future work orders by manual read-only feasibility and abort risk.
evidence_needs.expected_evidence_type: public accessibility and source navigation constraints
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Future operators may encounter interaction requirements too late.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: competitive pressure and adjacent alternatives remain unknown
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Supports future artifact claim boundaries without mutating strategy canonically.
evidence_needs.expected_evidence_type: public comparison, repository, documentation, or independent analysis
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Artifacts may overclaim uniqueness or understate existing alternatives.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: approval packets need source credibility requirements before any future real observation can be reviewed
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Defines what source provenance, trace, freshness, and reviewability must appear in future evidence packets.
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Approval packets cannot distinguish high-value sources from weak evidence surfaces.

evidence_needs.uncertainty_or_gap: contradiction and corroboration requirements are not yet attached to pilot run packages
evidence_needs.decision_relevance: Prevents single-source overconfidence and defines when evidence must be quarantined or corroborated.
evidence_needs.expected_evidence_type: conflicting or independently corroborating source trace
evidence_needs.consequence_if_missing: Future work orders may accept one weak source as sufficient.
